'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***The [[Kachin Independence Army]] launches a large offensive against junta outposts near [[Laiza]] and on the highway between [[Bhamo]] and [[Myitkyina]]. Five outposts are seized with fighting ongoing at five other outposts. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/northern-myanmar-kachin-rebels-claim-attacks-army-outposts-107886589 (ABC News)]
***Local [[People's Defence Force (Myanmar)|People's Defence Force]] groups capture the town of [[Kani, Myanmar|Kani]] in [[Sagaing Region]]. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/myanmar-resistance-fighters-poised-to-capture-key-town-in-sagaing-region.html (The Irrawaddy)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**[[Haiti]]'s main [[port|seaport]] [[Port international de Port-au-Prince]] suspends operations after being attacked and looted by armed gangs. The national [[state of emergency]] is also extended for another month amid ongoing [[civil disorder|civil unrest]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-68507837 (BBC News)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[Islamic Republic of Iran|Iran]] confiscates the cargo of the [[United States|America]]n [[oil tanker]] ''Advantage Sweet'' in response to [[United States sanctions against Iran|U.S.-led sanctions]] restricting the sale of [[medication]] for [[epidermolysis bullosa]] to Iran. [https://www.barrons.com/news/iran-seizes-us-cargo-on-oil-tanker-over-sanctions-judiciary-b68825e6 (''Barron's'')]
*[[Islamist insurgency in the Sahel]]
**The [[Alliance of Sahel States]], composed of [[Mali]], [[Burkina Faso]], and [[Niger]], announces the creation of a joint force to combat [[Jihadism|jihadist]] groups in the three countries. [https://www.africanews.com/2024/03/07/terrorism-in-the-sahel-aes-force-will-be-operational-as-soon-as-possible/ (Africanews)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]] 
**Gunmen kidnap at least 287 school children in [[Kaduna State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/03/08/africa/gunmen-kidnap-287-school-children-in-nigerias-northwest-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Gaza humanitarian crisis (2023–present)|Gaza humanitarian crisis]], [[Humanitarian aid during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Joe Biden]] announces the construction of a temporary [[pier]] on the coast of the [[Gaza Strip]] to facilitate large-scale delivery of [[humanitarian aid]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/mar/07/biden-us-port-gaza-aid-delivery (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/biden-announce-gaza-aid-port-construction-state-union-speech-2024-03-07/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Sweden–NATO relations]]
***[[Sweden]] officially joins [[NATO]], becoming its 32nd member. [https://www.reuters.com/world/sweden-set-become-natos-32nd-member-pm-visits-washington-2024-03-07/ (Reuters)] [https://www.nato.int/cps/en/natohq/news_223446.htm (NATO)]
*[[Lithuania–Russia relations]]
**[[Lithuania]] strips [[Russia]]n ballerina [[Ilze Liepa]] of her Lithuanian citizenship after she openly shows her sympathies for President [[Vladimir Putin]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2024/03/07/lithuania-strips-ballerinas-citizenship-over-pro-putin-remarks-a84380 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*[[Ukraine–United Kingdom relations]]
**Former [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] Chief of Staff [[Valerii Zaluzhnyi]] is appointed Ukrainian ambassador to the [[United Kingdom]] by President [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraines-zelenskiy-approves-ex-army-chief-zaluzhnyis-candidacy-envoy-uk-2024-03-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[New York (state)|New York State]] [[Governor of New York|Governor]] [[Kathy Hochul]] deploys 750 [[New York State Division of Military and Naval Affairs|national guard]] troops to the [[New York City]] subways to counter crime and a recent spike in violent assaults. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/new-york-deploy-750-national-guard-soldiers-check-bags-subway-2024-03-06/ (Reuters)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2024/03/07/new-york-subway-national-guard/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/nyc-subway-hochul-national-guard-violence/5203271/ (WNBC-TV)]
* An attack [[:es:Masacre de la Universidad Tecnológica de Guadalajara|inside the Tecnologic University of Guadalajara]], [[Guadalajara]], left two woman employees dead and other injured, and hours later other woman were killed in a motel in the same city. The attacker was not a student or the institution, and the motives of the attack could be copycat crime of other school massacres. [https://oem.com.mx/eloccidental/policiaca/agresor-de-la-uteg-no-era-alumno-fiscalia-del-estado-13149946 (El Occidental)]
